result.summary: The pedestrian environment at this signalized intersection is characterized by a complete lack of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, forcing people to navigate traffic without designated protection. Furthermore, a vehicle parked at the corner creates a significant visual obstruction, severely limiting sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No designated crossing area for pedestrians at a signalized intersection, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the intersection

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicle
hazards.description: A red car is parked at the corner, blocking sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground corner

hazards.name: Absence of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians must rely on vehicle signals, which may not provide adequate crossing time or clear indication of when to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Overhead at the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the corner to improve visibility for all road users and prevent sightline blockages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve safety and predictability for people crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten crossing distances and physically prevent illegal parking at the corner.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane intersection lacking marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. A derelict building with construction fencing further complicates the walking path and potentially limits visibility for all road users.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at this wide intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the intersection

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: The width of the street in the foreground

hazards.name: Construction Fencing
hazards.description: Fencing around the derelict building narrows the sidewalk and may create blind spots for turning vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Base of the tall building in the center background

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide multi-lane roadway lacking marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. Large parked vehicles, including a food truck, create significant visual obstructions between the sidewalk and the travel lanes, increasing the risk for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible across the wide multi-lane roadway, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected in a high-traffic environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and middle ground.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: A large food truck and van parked along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb line.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at potential crossing points to shorten crossing distances and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Enhance the existing median to include a protected waiting area for pedestrians, allowing them to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, unobstructed sidewalk in a commercial and institutional area. While the pedestrian walkway is in good condition, safety is compromised by the lack of visible crossing infrastructure and significant visual obstructions from large parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs are visible in this segment of the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway area in the foreground

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
